subject: Ridgeway Expo — Hall B intermittent network & speaker feed contingency
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@ridgewayexpo.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lim <marcus.lim@ridgewayexpo.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:14:12 -0800
Subject: Hall B network outage + vendor AV impact

Hi Neha —

We just experienced an ISP circuit blip in Hall B around 07:55; intermittent packet loss since then. Several exhibitor booths (including Booth 42) are reporting devices falling offline. The venue's primary carrier is investigating but estimates a 2–4 hour window for restoration.

Two notes: 1) Your booth's wired drop is showing up but DHCP is failing; devices can see the switch but no internet. 2) Keynote speaker at 10:30 (from Arcadia.ai) needs a live remote demo and may lose streaming if we don't provide backup.

I've attached the Hall B floorplan and shared the ops channel.

Can your team confirm whether you can:
- fail over the demo laptop to a 4G/5G hotspot from a vendor
- accept a temporary static IP from our guest VLAN for the demo machine

Sorry for the short notice — we know this is crunch time.

Thanks,
Samantha
Venue Operations
Ridgeway Tech Expo
attachments: hall-b-floorplan.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@ridgewayexpo.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:22:45 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hall B network outage + vendor AV impact

Samantha — thanks for the heads-up.

Quick plan from our side:
1) Connor, can you confirm inventory of the spare 4G router + SIMs on-site? If available, please ship to Booth 42 and label for "Arcadia demo".
2) Tessa, I want the speaker briefed: offer telepresence fallback (pre-record run-through + slides only) if live demo can't be supported. Marissa, please stand by to switch the session to webcast.
3) Samantha — yes to a temp guest VLAN/static IP; please share VLAN creds and MAC allowlist window.

We can also run a local NAT from the demo laptop to the hotspot. Connor, if you can drop a quick config snippet (IP, gateway, DNS) in reply, I'll pass to the speaker.

-Neha
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@ridgewayexpo.com>, Greg Alvarez <greg@standsupplies.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:45:03 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hall B network outage + vendor AV impact

On it — inventory check below.

Available on-site: 1x CradlePoint R198 (spare), 2x GL-iNet GL-X180 hotspots (pre-provisioned), 3x vendor SIMs (Verizon) with data pools.
Spare edge router serials attached (router-serials.csv).

I will:
- Drop CradlePoint and one GL-X180 at Booth 42 now (ETA 25 mins).
- Preconfigure NAT and local DHCP so the demo laptop gets 10.0.25.10 and DNS to 1.1.1.1.
- Hold one hotspot for the speaker podium as primary fallback.

Config snippet for Neha/speaker to paste:
- IP: 10.0.25.10/24
- Gateway: 10.0.25.1
- DNS: 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8
- Notes: firewall allows outbound 443/80/3478-3481 for STUN/TURN if streaming.

Greg — can StandUp Supplies confirm same-day swap price and whether you can send a 4G antenna for better uplink?

-Connor
Field Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: router-serials.csv
From: Greg Alvarez <greg@standsupplies.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:02:27 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hall B network outage + vendor AV impact

Connor — we can deliver a bonded 4G kit and a directional antenna within 45 minutes. On-site charge applied per your account (we'll waive delivery for Redwood at Ridgeway this weekend).

I will bring: Bonded router (PicoCell x2), 4G antenna, 10m Ethernet patch, and a laptop to confirm tunnel. Leave the config to you; I'll hand off once up.

Greg
StandUp Supplies (Vendor)
Mobile: +1 415-555-0198
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha@ridgewayexpo.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:18:11 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hall B network outage + vendor AV impact

Quick status for comms and flow:
- I've looped Arcadia's speaker (Olivia Park) and asked for a 10:15 call to test the stream. If we can't get a clean feed by 10:05 we switch to the pre-recorded short demo and run a live Q&A.
- Booth staff: label all devices with booth number and attach asset tag stickers — helps with MAC allowlist.
- I'll stage a backup laptop with local copy of the demo (USB + local server) just in case.

If the bonded link arrives, I want a 5-minute smoke test by 09:50. Connor — can you confirm the tunnel endpoint and throughput target (we should aim for >6Mbps up).

-Marissa
Field Events Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: speaker-kit-checklist.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@ridgewayexpo.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Greg Alvarez <greg@standsupplies.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 18:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Hall B network outage + vendor AV impact

Final wrap — post-event summary for the record:

What happened:
- Primary Hall B carrier had a regional routing issue between 07:50–09:30. Intermittent packet loss impacted several booths and the keynote feed.

Actions taken:
- StandUp Supplies delivered bonded 4G kit + antenna; Connor and Greg completed handoff at 09:20.
- Configured NAT/DHCP on CradlePoint; demo laptop assigned 10.0.25.10; smoke test throughput: 8.2 Mbps up, 22 Mbps down.
- Speaker (Olivia Park, Arcadia.ai) ran live demo on bonded link at 10:30 after a 5-minute delay; we ran one local pre-record backup for 3 minutes during a transient reconnect.
- Marissa coordinated switch to webcast and handled participant Q&A during the swap.

Follow-ups and asks:
- Samantha: please add the circuit incident report from your carrier to the Drive folder (link above).
- Venue: confirm whether Hall B will add a permanent secondary carrier access point (we recommend).
- Ops: Connor, please add the router serials to the event inventory and bill StandUp Supplies via PO 8993.

Thanks to everyone for the fast response — saved the keynote and minimized attendee impact. I'll compile a short post-mortem and runbook updates by Dec 3.

-Neha
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
